messages:
Sam T.: Quick follow-up from the all-hands reliability segment. Dropping the items we promised to track + owners. RCA: https://docs.redwood.com/rcas/INC-3841 — please keep replies short so I can roll up a status.

Priya N.: Thanks Sam. For the fallback routing work we discussed, can we get a firm canary date? Product teams asked for a calendar invite.

Luis G.: +1 from support — need the date and rollback signal so on-call can prepare runbooks.

Sam T.: Proposed canary start: 2026-04-07 (prod-canary region). Duration: 72h monitored window. If that works I'll create the invite.

Priya N.: Works for product. Can you document the success criteria? We said SLOs + error budget constraints in the Q&A.

Luis G.: Suggestion for rollback/success signals (short list):
- 5xx spike > 0.4% sustained for 10m -> rollback
- p95 latency +20% vs baseline over 10m -> rollback
- user-impact error reports (>=3 P1 tickets) -> pause and triage
I'll add these to the canary checklist.

Sam T.: Agree with Luis, will standardize into the checklist. Also note: we will route a small % of traffic first (1%), then 5%, then 20% if green.

Amy L.: Who's owning the RCA action register? Need weekly snapshot for execs.

Priya N.: I'll maintain the register and publish Friday EOD. Owners so far: fallback routing canary -> @Sam T., tracing retention increase -> @Luis G., customer follow-up pack -> @Amy L.

Luis G.: On tracing retention: infra asked if the increase will need budget sign-off. Rough estimate is $3.2k/mo for the change size we discussed.

Amy L.: If it's under $5k/mo I can ok it with the finance liaison. I'll put finance on the register so we have a record.

Sam T.: Ops deploy note for implementers (example):
```
# apply fallback routing in canary
kubectl -n infra apply -f configs/fallback-routing-2026-04-07.yaml --context=prod-canary
```
Keep rollout pause windows at 10m between steps.

Deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for fallback-routing-2026-04-07 in prod-canary at 2026-03-26T14:05:12Z (build 1237).

Priya N.: I posted a short runbook and the action register here: https://docs.redwood.com/runbooks/allhands-followup-2026-03. Will add test owners by EOD.

Luis G.: One more ask from eng-sre: can we add tracing tag examples so partner teams know what to search for? I'll paste a small snippet in the runbook in a sec.

Sam T.: Thanks everyone. I'll consolidate into the master action register and send the weekly update Friday. Ping me if blocked. :raised_hands:
